name: Doñana National Park
description: Doñana is a vast wetland in Andalusia, southern Spain, where the Guadalquivir River spills into the Atlantic. Marshes, lagoons, shifting dunes and scrubby woodland sit side by side, sheltering Iberian lynx and Spanish imperial eagles. It is also a crossroads for migrating birds travelling between Europe and Africa, with over 300 species recorded each year.
